title: head opens the workspace_registry (schema 14) that cmux-tui-v0.13.0 wrote
preconditions: state root unpacked from tests/oracle/fixtures/state-roots/cmux-tui-v0.13.0.tar.gz, every file at its manifest's sha256
no daemon before the first step

expect.noReceiptReason: a daemon start answers no request, so it has no receipt; it is ready or it exits

steps.note: head starts on the root cmux-tui-v0.13.0 wrote (tests/oracle/fixtures/state-roots/cmux-tui-v0.13.0.tar.gz)
head's facet; every value cmux-tui-v0.13.0 read back from its own root is here unchanged

invariants: read: every value of the facet cmux-tui-v0.13.0 read from its root (the manifest's facet, without /clients, /cursor, /session/generation, /session/revision) is at the same pointer in head's, equal; head may add members
after head stops, its __store-schemas --stored reports workspace_registry at 15, the schema head reads: head migrated the store and kept it
teardown: verify no case process is left
untested: terminals: a packed root holds no live terminal host; host adoption across builds belongs to the terminal-host protocol (docs/cloud-guest-upgrades.md)
